title: Plex Recently Added Widget Schema
description: Configuration schema for Plex recently-added media widget

serverUrl.label: Plex Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400)

libraries.label: Library Names (optional)
libraries.description: Filter to specific library names; leave empty to show all

maxItems.label: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of recently-added items to display

refreshInterval.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh the widget data in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour)
